scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: eslint shared/src shared/test server/src server/test client/src client/test
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
